senses.definition_en: statesman, stateswoman

examples.english: It's even more ridiculous that the character of Aragorn, a polyglot statesman who advocates knowledge and inclusion of the various races, customs and languages of Middle-earth, is used to legitimize an anti-immigrant, anti-feminist and Islamophobic political group.
examples.ref: 2019 May 7, Viggo Mortensen, “La torpeza política y mediática de Vox”, in El País, Madrid, →ISSN:
examples.text: Es aún más ridículo que se utilice el personaje de Aragorn, un estadista políglota que aboga por el conocimiento y la inclusión de las diversas razas, costumbres y lenguas de la Tierra Media, para legitimar a un grupo político antinmigrante, antifeminista e islamófobo.
examples.translation: It's even more ridiculous that the character of Aragorn, a polyglot statesman who advocates knowledge and inclusion of the various races, customs and languages of Middle-earth, is used to legitimize an anti-immigrant, anti-feminist and Islamophobic political group.
